about.metaDescription: Learn about Cangday — a modern fragrance house offering an edited collection of designer and niche perfumes for everyday wear.
about.tagline: A modern fragrance house — an edited collection of designer and niche perfumes for everyday wear.
about.storyHeadline: Fragrance shouldn't require a lecture on notes and sillage to enjoy.
about.storyP1: Cangday is a tightly edited collection of designer and niche perfumes — chosen for how they actually wear, not just how they're marketed. No endless scroll of near-identical bottles, no pressure to know your fragrance family before you buy.
about.storyP2: Every order is checked, packed to survive the trip and handed to cargo the same day. We'd rather sell you the right bottle once than sell you five you'll never wear.
about.capability1: A tightly edited catalog, not an endless scroll
about.capability2: Designer and niche fragrances side by side
about.capability3: Every bottle checked before it ships
about.capability4: Secure packaging built for fragile glass
about.capability5: Clear, upfront pricing — no surprises at checkout
about.capability6: Fast order processing and shipping updates
about.capability7: Responsive support if anything needs fixing
about.capability8: Orders handed to cargo the same day, straight to your door

privacy.metaDescription: How Cangday collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you place an order.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Cangday ("we," "us," "our") is an online fragrance retailer. This policy explains what personal information we collect through this site, how we use it, and who we share it with.
privacy.s1Body1: Order information. When you place an order, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and shipping address (country, city, and street address).
privacy.s1Body2: Shopping cart. The contents of your shopping cart are stored locally in your browser (using browser local storage) and are only sent to us once you submit an order at checkout.
privacy.s2Item1: To process, fulfill, and communicate with you about your order.
privacy.s2Item2: To calculate shipping costs and coordinate delivery.
privacy.s2Item3: To send order confirmation and status emails.
privacy.s2Item4: To respond to inquiries you send us directly.
privacy.s2Body: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
privacy.s3Body: We use a small number of service providers to run the store. They only receive the information needed to perform their function on our behalf:
privacy.s3Item1: Supabase — hosts our database and stores order records.
privacy.s4Body: We use browser local storage to remember your shopping bag and favourites between visits. If you accept the cookie notice, we also use Google Analytics cookies to measure visits and purchases in aggregate and improve the store; if you decline, Analytics only receives anonymous, cookieless signals. We do not use advertising cookies. You can change your choice at any time by clearing this site’s data in your browser. If you sign in to our admin dashboard, we use a session cookie to keep you signed in.
privacy.s5Body: We retain order records for as long as necessary to fulfill your order and to meet our accounting and legal record-keeping obligations.
privacy.s6Body: You can contact us to request access to, correction of, or deletion of the personal information we hold about you. We'll respond to verified requests as quickly as we can.
privacy.s7Body: Cangday is a general retail fragrance store not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.
privacy.s8Body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above.
privacy.s9Body: Questions about this policy or your data? See our {link}.

terms.metaDescription: The terms that apply to orders placed with Cangday.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Cangday is an online fragrance retailer. By browsing this site or placing an order, you agree to these terms.
terms.s1Body: Product photos and descriptions are representative of the item shipped; minor variation in packaging or bottle design can occur between production batches. Prices are shown in the currency displayed at checkout and are confirmed at the time of purchase.
terms.s2Body: Submitting the checkout form places your order with us. We'll confirm shipping details by email and keep you updated until your order arrives.
terms.s3Body: Shipping costs and delivery timelines vary by destination and shipping method. See our <link>Shipping & Delivery</link> page for current rates.
terms.s4Body: Orders are handed to our cargo partner the same day they are confirmed, and you pay in cash on delivery. If a bottle arrives damaged or isn't what you ordered, <link>contact us</link> with your order details and we'll make it right.
terms.s5Body: You can cancel or change an order at no cost any time before it ships — just <link>contact us</link>.
terms.s6Body: All text, images, and branding on this site belong to Cangday and may not be reproduced without our permission.
terms.s7Body: We aim for accuracy in everything we publish, but we're not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of this website or delays outside our reasonable control (for example, customs or carrier delays).
terms.s8Body: These terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which Cangday is registered.
terms.s9Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above.
terms.s10Body: Questions about an order or these terms? See our <contactLink>Contact page</contactLink>. For how we handle your personal information, see our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.
